_comment: Advisory planning lints, surfaced at draft time by ct2-seal / ct2-ticket-audit --seal-gate (see spec/state-machine.md, 'Advisory planning lints'). Each lint scans one draft ticket section with a regex and adds a NON-BLOCKING advisory when it triggers. Lints never fail the seal gate; the seven blocking checks are unchanged. Helm appends entries only after explicit user approval (a corroborated lesson with a regex-expressible pattern is the natural source).

_example.advice: Bug-fix tickets should bind an acceptance criterion to a regression test.
